BiblicalUsage: The upper room, the chamber on the roof, the stairway up. Daniel's windows were open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, and he kneeled upon his knees three times a day and prayed, even after the king's decree made prayer a death sentence; the upper room is where a man prays when no one can stop him.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for an upstairs room carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the praying room, that Daniel prayed there three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem.
